settings.title: Settings
team.ascension_desc.3: + Crystal starts with 15% less max HP.
team.ascension_desc.5: + All of the above; enemy HP scales 8% per level.
team.subtitle: You can recruit up to 6 heroes during the run.
team.title: Choose two starting heroes
tutorial.1: Your heroes defend the Crystal automatically. Watch them fight!
tutorial.2: Between waves, drag heroes to nodes near the red lane arrows.
tutorial.3: Different elements combine into reactions. Mix your team!
tutorial.4: Use 2× speed when the wave is under control.
wave.1.hint: A small pack from the east. Your heroes fight on their own.
wave.1.name: First Contact
wave.10.hint: Mini-boss! Armor Crack and Superconduct break its armored phase.
wave.10.name: Siegebreaker
wave.11.hint: Massive swarm with a hasted Ravager from the north.
wave.11.name: Swarm and Fang
wave.12.hint: Ranged casters target your heroes from 3.6 m.
wave.12.name: Hexfire Line
wave.13.hint: Sappers ignore heroes and explode on the Crystal. Kill them on the way.
wave.13.name: Siege Sappers
wave.14.hint: Everything at once, with banners buffing allies.
wave.14.name: Mixed Assault
wave.15.hint: Two hardened elites. A pact will be offered after this wave.
wave.15.name: Twin Ravagers
wave.16.hint: New diagonal lanes open; enemies are hasted this wave.
wave.16.name: Diagonal Breach
wave.17.hint: Mimics adapt to your strongest element. Diverse damage wins.
wave.17.name: Prism Hunt
wave.18.hint: Sappers, juggernauts and summoners on six lanes.
wave.18.name: Siege Escalation
wave.19.hint: The final shop follows. Prepare for the Warden.
wave.19.name: Last Stand
wave.2.hint: Enemies from east and west; hounds rush the east late.
wave.2.name: Two Fronts
wave.20.hint: Three phases: summons, a marked lane assault, then a slam sequence followed by an Exposed window.
wave.20.name: The Rift Warden
wave.3.name: The Swarm
wave.4.hint: Fast runners from west and south. Block their paths.
wave.4.name: Hound Rush
wave.5.hint: An elite with telegraphed charges. Spread out of the red circles.
wave.5.name: Ravager
wave.6.name: Four Winds
wave.7.hint: Shieldbearers block frontal hits: flank them or crack their armor.
wave.7.name: Iron Wall
wave.8.hint: Summoners and casters join from the northeast.
wave.8.name: Crossroads
wave.9.hint: Warded golems resist Fire, Ice or Lightning (see their ward). Mix your elements.
wave.9.name: Warded Vanguard
